findings.desc: In isogenic human iPSC-derived ApoE3 vs ApoE4 astrocytes, ApoE4-induced cholesterol accumulation impaired lysosome-dependent removal of damaged mitochondria on ultrastructural and autophagy-flux analyses, directly linking the ApoE4 lipid defect to failed lysosomal clearance (abstract-level extraction; no PMCID/full text available).
findings.quote: Ultrastructural and autophagy flux analyses show that ApoE4-induced cholesterol accumulation impairs lysosome-dependent removal of damaged mitochondria.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lysosomal cholesterol accumulation impairs lysosome-dependent removal of damaged mitochondria / autophagic flux)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived ApoE3 and ApoE4 astrocytes; ultrastructure and autophagy-flux analysis of mitophagy

findings.desc: Acute cholesterol depletion restored autophagic activity, mitochondrial dynamics and associated proteomes in ApoE4 astrocytes, and extended treatment rescued mitochondrial respiration, showing the lysosomal/autophagic defect is caused by the cholesterol accumulation and is reversible (abstract-level extraction).
findings.quote: Acute treatment with cholesterol-depleting agents restores autophagic activity, mitochondrial dynamics, and associated proteomes, and extended treatment rescues mitochondrial respiration in ApoE4 astrocytes.
findings.summary: (cholesterol depletion in APOE4 astrocytes) -> (autophagic activity restored)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived ApoE4 astrocytes treated with cholesterol-depleting agents; autophagy activity and mitochondrial respiration assays

findings.desc: In human iPSC-derived neurons, ApoE particles carrying the polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester CE(20:4) induced lysosomal lipofuscin accumulation (lipofuscinosis, a lysosomal pathology from lipid peroxidation) in an isoform-graded manner, ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2, with lipofuscin localised in LAMP1-positive lysosomes; the ApoE4-ApoE3 difference grew over 14-21 days of exposure.
findings.quote: Longitudinal live imaging of CE(20:4)-lipApoE-treated iNeurons revealed both ApoE isoform-dependent and time-dependent accumulation of autofluorescence indicative of lipofuscin (Figure S5E-F, Figure 5A-B).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, PUFA-CE cargo) -> (greater lysosomal lipofuscin accumulation / lipofuscinosis in human neurons)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived NGN2 neurons treated with CE(20:4)/POPC-lipidated ApoE2, ApoE3 or ApoE4 particles; longitudinal live imaging of lipofuscin autofluorescence and LAMP1 co-localisation

findings.desc: Neurons pre-loaded with CE(20:4)-lipApoE showed increased endolysosomal accumulation of internalised pHrodo-labelled tau preformed fibrils, trending ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2 and most pronounced in lipofuscin-positive neurons, indicating lipofuscin-laden lysosomes clear tau fibrils less effectively.
findings.quote: After another 13-14 d incubation, total pHrodo signals from tau pffs that were internalized and accumulated in the endolysosomes demonstrated a trend of ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2 > K146E ApoE4, with the isoform-dependent difference being more pronounced among lipofuscin-positive neurons (Figure 6H-I)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, PUFA-CE cargo) -> (increased endolysosomal accumulation of tau fibrils, i.e. impaired lysosomal clearance)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived NGN2 neurons pre-treated 14 d with CE(20:4)-lipidated ApoE isoforms, then incubated with pHrodo-labelled tau preformed fibrils; endolysosomal pHrodo quantification

findings.desc: In human postmortem dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (ROSMAP), the cholesterol transporter ABCA1 was more abundant in lysosome-enriched (LAMP2-immunoprecipitated) fractions in AD than in non-cognitively-impaired brain within the APOE3/4 genotype but not the APOE3/3 genotype, i.e. lysosomal trapping of ABCA1 is an APOE4-associated phenotype; lysosomal ABCA1 also correlated with phosphorylated mTOR (R2 = 0.59, p < 0.0001, Fig 2D).
findings.quote: ABCA1 was more abundant in lysosome-enriched fractions in the AD group than in the NCI group within the APOE3/4 genotype but not in the APOE3/3 genotype
findings.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE3/4, AD brain) -> (more ABCA1 trapped in lysosomes)
findings.exp_system: Human postmortem mid-frontal cortex from ROSMAP (NCI vs AD, APOE3/3 vs APOE3/4); LAMP2 immunoprecipitation of lysosome-enriched fractions and Western blot

findings.desc: Treating APOE4-targeted-replacement mice for 2 months with hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin lowered brain oxysterols and reduced lysosomal ABCA1 trapping, mTORC1 activation, senescence and neuroinflammation, and increased ABCA1/endo-lysosome recycling, tying the lysosomal defect to the cholesterol (oxysterol) accumulation.
findings.quote: Treatment of APOE4-TR mice with cyclodextrin reduced brain oxysterol levels, ABCA1 lysosome trapping, mTORC1 activation, and attenuated senescence and neuroinflammation markers.
findings.summary: (oxysterol reduction by cyclodextrin in APOE4-TR mice) -> (less lysosomal ABCA1 trapping and restored endo-lysosome recycling)
findings.exp_system: APOE4-targeted-replacement mice treated with hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin or PBS for 2 months from 8 months of age (n = 14 PBS, n = 15 HPCD); brain oxysterol mass spectrometry and lysosomal ABCA1/recycling assays

findings.desc: In primary astrocytes from APOE-targeted-replacement mice, ApoE4 raised ARF6 expression compared with ApoE3, trapping the cholesterol transporter ABCA1 in late endosomes and impairing its recycling to the cell membrane, which lowered ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux (abstract-level extraction; publisher does not release the full text in XML).
findings.quote: We found that ApoE4 promoted greater expression of ARF6 compared with ApoE3, trapping ABCA1 in late-endosomes and impairing its recycling to the cell membrane.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (ABCA1 trapped in late endosomes, impaired recycling and cholesterol efflux)
findings.exp_system: Primary astrocytes from human APOE3- and APOE4-targeted-replacement mice; ABCA1 membrane trafficking/recycling and cholesterol efflux assays

findings.desc: Human CSF from APOE epsilon4/epsilon4 carriers had a lower capacity to drive ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux (and more aggregated ApoE) than CSF from epsilon3/epsilon3 carriers, extending the late-endosomal ABCA1 trafficking/egress defect to a human sample (abstract-level extraction).
findings.quote: Human CSF from APOE ε4/ε4 carriers showed a lower ability to induce ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux activity and greater percentage of aggregated ApoE protein compared with CSF from APOE ε3/ε3 carriers.
findings.summary: (APOE epsilon3/epsilon3 -> epsilon4/epsilon4 human CSF) -> (lower ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux capacity)
findings.exp_system: Human CSF from APOE epsilon3/epsilon3 and epsilon4/epsilon4 carriers applied to ABCA1-expressing cells; cholesterol efflux capacity assay

findings.desc: In immortalized APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes, lysosomal Ca2+ handling was dysregulated: the GPN-releasable Ca2+ content of lysosome-enriched acidic stores (area under the curve after osmotic lysis of acidic stores with GPN) was greater in APOE4 cells, and NAADP/acidic-store Ca2+ release accounted for the APOE4 Ca2+ hyperactivity.
findings.quote: The results showed greater AUC in APOE4 cells (Fig. 4d), supporting a higher concentration of lysosomal-related Ca2+ in APOE4 cells, as compared to APOE3.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased lysosomal acidic-store Ca2+ content and dysregulated lysosomal Ca2+ release in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Immortalized astrocytes expressing APOE3 or APOE4; Ca2+ imaging with GPN lysis of acidic stores and NAADP-receptor blockade (Ned-19)

findings.desc: APOE4 astrocyte lysosomes were more alkaline than APOE3 lysosomes by 0.14 pH units despite higher expression of the V-ATPase subunit V0D1 (Fig 4f), i.e. acidification is impaired and maintained only with compensatory proton-pump upregulation coupled to Ca2+/H+ exchange.
findings.quote: We found that both APOE3 and APOE4 astrocytes had standard lysosomal-related pH, with a minimal but significant difference of 0.14 pH units between genotypes, APOE4 lysosomes being more alkaline (Fig. 4g).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lysosomes 0.14 pH units more alkaline despite increased V-ATPase, i.e. impaired acidification)
findings.exp_system: Immortalized APOE3 and APOE4 astrocytes; LysoSensor fluorometric pH measurement of acidic organelles and V-ATPase V0D1 Western blot

findings.desc: APOE4 astrocytes showed aberrant intracellular cholesterol distribution - more cholesterol in intracellular clumps and less at the plasma membrane than APOE3 cells on filipin staining, pointing to impaired cholesterol efflux - and the lipid composition of lysosomal membranes differed distinctly between genotypes on lipidomics (PLS-DA clustering, Fig 8b).
findings.quote: We found aberrant intracellular distribution of cholesterol in APOE4 astrocytes, which presented more cholesterol in intracellular clumps, and less in plasma membrane, than APOE3 cells (Fig. 8a).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (cholesterol redistributed to intracellular stores, less at plasma membrane; distinct lysosomal membrane lipid composition)
findings.exp_system: Immortalized APOE3 and APOE4 astrocytes; filipin III cholesterol staining and untargeted lipidomics of isolated lysosomal membranes

findings.desc: In P301S tauopathy mice, ApoE4 (TE4) vs ApoE3 (TE3) drove glial lipid accumulation with neutral-lipid (BODIPY+) inclusions located predominantly within CD68+ microglial phagolysosomes, which the authors interpret as impaired lysosomal degradation of neutral lipids including cholesteryl esters.
findings.quote: the BODIPY signals were predominantly located within CD68+ phagolysosomes in microglia (Fig. 2C-E), indicating that the process of lysosomal degradation of neutral lipids, including CE, might be impaired in TE4 mice
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, tauopathy brain) -> (neutral lipid/cholesteryl ester accumulation within microglial phagolysosomes, suggesting impaired lysosomal lipid degradation)
findings.exp_system: P301S tau transgenic mice with human ApoE3 (TE3) or ApoE4 (TE4) targeted replacement, 9.5 months old; BODIPY/CD68/Iba1 co-immunostaining of hippocampal microglia

findings.desc: Increasing glial lipid efflux with the LXR agonist GW3965 reduced microglial BODIPY (phagolysosomal neutral lipid) signal by ~50% in TE4 mice and attenuated tau pathology/neurodegeneration, supporting a causal lipid-efflux-to-lysosome link; LXR activation also raised endolysosomal BMP lipids, indicating activation of endolysosomal function (Fig 7C-D).
findings.quote: we performed BODIPY staining in TE4 mice on control vs. LXR agonist diet and observed a ~50% reduction in BODIPY signal in microglia of TE4-LXR vs. TE4-Ctrl mice (Fig. 7H and I)
findings.summary: (LXR agonist / increased glial cholesterol efflux in APOE4 tauopathy mice) -> (~50% less microglial phagolysosomal lipid accumulation)
findings.exp_system: P301S/ApoE4 (TE4) mice fed GW3965-supplemented chow from 6 to 9.5 months; BODIPY staining of hippocampal microglia

findings.desc: Even without tauopathy, ApoE4 (but not ApoE3) forebrain showed drastic increases in the endolysosomal phospholipid BMP (a lysosome-resident lipid whose accumulation marks endolysosomal dysfunction) versus ApoE-knockout, alongside lower cholesteryl esters, indicating isoform-dependent changes in cholesterol metabolism and lysosomal function.
findings.quote: E4 but not E3 forebrains exhibited drastic increases in endolysosomal phospholipid BMP, DGs and MGs, and PEs while accumulating significantly lower levels of CEs when compared to EKO mice (Fig. S1E-F).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased endolysosomal BMP, a marker of endolysosomal dysfunction, in forebrain)
findings.exp_system: Forebrain lipidomics of 9.5-month-old non-tau APOE3-, APOE4- and ApoE-knockout targeted-replacement mice

findings.desc: Confirmed on the lysosomal cholesterol sequestration/egress arm only: in isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes, lysosomal free cholesterol (filipin co-localisation with endocytosed TRITC-dextran, a measure of lysosomal cholesterol) was significantly increased 3-fold (p < 0.001) in APOE4 vs APOE3 cells, i.e. cholesterol is sequestered in lysosomes and fails to egress, despite elevated total intracellular cholesterol driving paradoxical de novo synthesis.
findings.quote: Filipin and TRITC-Dextran co-localization (yellow puncta), a measure of lysosomal cholesterol, was significantly increased (3-fold, p<0.001) in APOE4 compared to APOE3 astrocytes, indicating that intracellular free cholesterol accumulates in lysosomes (Figure 6H).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (3-fold more cholesterol sequestered in astrocyte lysosomes, i.e. failed lysosomal cholesterol egress)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived APOE3 and APOE4 astrocytes; filipin staining co-localised with endocytosed TRITC-dextran (lysosomal compartment)

findings.desc: Consistent with failed lysosomal cholesterol egress, the lysosomal cholesterol-export machinery was reduced in APOE4 glia: the lysosome gene set was negatively enriched and SMPD1, NPC1 and NPC2 (and LAMP1/2) were lower in APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes/microglia, which the authors state indicates cholesterol transport out of lysosomes may be impaired by APOE4.
findings.quote: Negatively enriched Lysosome (Figures 2F and S3D) and lower SMPD1, NPC1 and NPC2 in APOE4 vs. APOE3 astrocytes (Figure S6D) indicates cholesterol transport out of lysosomes may be impaired by APOE4.
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived APOE3 and APOE4 astrocytes and microglia; transcriptomics/proteomics of lysosomal cholesterol-export genes

findings.desc: Confirmed on the lysosomal cholesterol sequestration/egress arm only: in isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes, colocalisation of filipin III (non-membrane-bound cholesterol) with dextran-Alexa 555 (lysosomal compartment) was highest in APOE4 cells (ordering E4 > E3 = KO > E2 in the authors' summary), i.e. an isoform-graded lysosomal cholesterol sequestration phenotype; no direct lysosomal function assay difference between APOE4 and APOE3 is claimed here.
findings.quote: Further colocalization of Filipin III with Dextran-Alexa 555 was highest in APOE4 iAstrocytes, indicating higher cholesterol levels in lysosomes of APOE4 iAstrocytes (E4 > E2) (Figure 3G).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more cholesterol localised in astrocyte lysosomes, i.e. lysosomal cholesterol sequestration)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes (APOE2, E3, E4, APOE-KO); filipin III staining co-localised with dextran-Alexa 555 after methyl-beta-cyclodextrin treatment

findings.desc: Non-membrane-bound (free) cholesterol was increased in APOE4 iAstrocytes (E4 > E3 = E2 = KO) while cholesterol efflux and biosynthesis were reduced in APOE4 cells, the cellular context for the lysosomal sequestration: cholesterol that cannot be effluxed accumulates intracellularly and is translocated into lysosomes.
findings.quote: We found that non-membrane-bound cholesterol was increased in APOE4 iAstrocytes (E4 > E3 = E2 = KO) (Figure 3F).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased intracellular free cholesterol with reduced cholesterol efflux)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes (APOE2, E3, E4, APOE-KO); filipin III quantification of non-membrane-bound cholesterol and HPTLC cholesterol efflux/biosynthesis assays
